sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 完形填空 (每小题1分, 共15分)
sections.passage:
Hello! My name is Jack. I'm [1] Taiyuan. I'm in No. 5 Middle School. It's [2] good school. My student ID card(学生证) [3] is 2016701. John is [4] English friend. His last name is [5]. John is in Taiyuan No. 12 Middle School. We can [6] in the evening. Sally and Jane are John's [7] sisters. Sally is 10 years old. Her favourite [8] is red. So her jacket and pen are [9]. Jane is only 2 years old. She can say "[10] are you?" to me now.

Can you see the man? He is my English teacher. His name is Jim Smith. Jim is his [11] and Smith is his family name. He is from London, [12]. He is 40 years old. He is tall and thin(瘦的). His favourite [13] is basketball. He can [14] English very well. He is very [15] to us. We all like him.

questions.translation: 你好！我的名字叫杰克。我来自太原。
questions.explanation: be from 表示“来自……”，用来介绍籍贯或来源地，be from Taiyuan 意为“来自太原”。故选B。

questions.translation: 它是一所好学校。
questions.explanation: school是可数名词单数，且good以辅音音素开头，表示“一所好学校”用不定冠词a。故选A。

questions.translation: 我的学生证号码是2016701。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“is 2016701”可知，这是一串数字，ID card number意为“证件号码”。故选D。

questions.translation: 约翰是我的英国朋友。
questions.explanation: 全文以第一人称杰克的视角展开叙述，此处介绍“我的朋友”，应用形容词性物主代词my。故选A。

questions.translation: 他的姓是布朗。
questions.explanation: last name意为“姓氏”，四个选项中Mike、Tom、Jim均为常见的名字（first name），只有Brown是姓氏。故选C。

questions.translation: 我们可以在晚上见面。
questions.explanation: 前文提到两人在不同的中学，此处表示“我们可以在晚上见面”，meet意为“见面/相见”。故选B。

questions.translation: 萨莉和简是约翰的两个妹妹。
questions.explanation: Sally and Jane是两个人，因此是two sisters。故选B。

questions.translation: 她最喜欢的颜色是红色。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“is red”可知，red是一种颜色，故此处指最喜欢的颜色（colour）。故选D。

questions.translation: 所以她的夹克和钢笔都是红色的。
questions.explanation: 前面提到“Her favourite colour is red”，用So引出结果，说明她的夹克和钢笔也是红色的（red）。故选A。

questions.translation: 她现在能对我说“你好吗？”了。
questions.explanation: How are you?是常用的问候语，意为“你好吗？”，故选How。故选C。

questions.translation: 吉姆是他的名，而史密斯是他的姓。
questions.explanation: 在英文人名Jim Smith中，Jim是名（first name），Smith是姓（family name/last name）。故选A。

questions.translation: 他来自英国伦敦。
questions.explanation: London（伦敦）是England（英国）的首都，London, England符合英文地址表达习惯。故选B。

questions.translation: 他最喜欢的运动是篮球。
questions.explanation: basketball（篮球）属于一项体育运动（sport）。故选D。

questions.translation: 他的英语讲得非常好。
questions.explanation: 讲某种语言用动词speak，speak English意为“讲英语”。故选B。

questions.translation: 他对我们非常友善。我们都很喜欢他。
questions.explanation: be kind to sb.是固定搭配，意为“对某人友善”，与后文“We all like him”语意呼应。故选C。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
**Come and Meet My New Friends!** They are all my new friends! I love to talk with them on the Internet. Here is some information about them.

This girl's name is Anna. She is 15 years old. She has long black hair and a big mouth. She has big eyes. She likes hot pot very much.

Look at this boy. He's Mike. He's from England. He is 14 years old. He has two big eyes and a small nose. He thinks tofu is very delicious.

This girl is from America. She is Diana. She has curly hair and a small nose. She has two big eyes and she is very cute.

Her name is Li Ting. Li is her last name and Ting is her first name. She is from Beijing, China. She has short black hair, a small nose, a small mouth and two big eyes.

questions.translation: 谁来自英国？
questions.explanation: 根据文中关于Mike的介绍“Look at this boy. He's Mike. He's from England.”可知迈克来自英国。故选B。

questions.prompt: 17. What does Diana's hair look like?
questions.translation: 戴安娜的头发看起来是什么样的？
questions.explanation: 根据文中关于Diana的描述“She is Diana. She has curly hair and a small nose.”可知她的头发是卷曲的（curly）。故选C。

questions.prompt: 18. About Li Ting, which of the following is TRUE?
questions.translation: 关于李婷，下列哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据文中关于Li Ting的介绍“She has short black hair, a small nose, a small mouth and two big eyes.”可知她有一个小嘴巴。故选D。

questions.prompt: 19. Which of the following can't we know from the passage?
questions.translation: 根据短文内容，我们无法得知以下哪一项？
questions.explanation: 文中明确提及Mike来自England（A已知），Diana来自America（B已知），Anna是15岁（C已知）；而对Li Ting只介绍了姓名、国籍和外貌，未提及她的年龄。故选D。

questions.prompt: 20. What's the best title for the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章最好的标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章首句明确指出“Come and Meet My New Friends! They are all my new friends!”，随后分别介绍了在网上结识的四位新朋友，故最佳标题为“My New Friends”。故选A。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，根据短文内容选择最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Fred. Nice to meet you! I'm 13 years old. I'm in No. 1 Middle School. I am often in a white jacket. That's my favourite colour. Do you know what my favourite subject is? It's science.

I can do a lot of things. I love sports and I can play football well. I can draw beautiful pictures. I can speak some <u>simple</u> Chinese, like "nihao" and "zaijian".

I like making friends. Bill is my first friend in the middle school. His mother is our English teacher Mrs Black. We are in the same neighbourhood (街区), so we go to school together every morning. I have some other friends in the middle school. Jack is one of them. He is also my cousin. He is in No. 1 Middle School, too, but we are in different grades. He is in Grade 8 and I'm in Grade 7. Jack and I are both in the same sports club.

This is me. Would you like to be friends with me?

questions.prompt:
21. What can we know about Fred from Paragraph 1?
① His age.
② His favourite food.
③ His favourite subject.
④ His favourite colour.
questions.translation:
从第一段中我们可以了解关于弗雷德的哪些信息？
① 他的年龄。
② 他最喜欢的食物。
③ 他最喜欢的科目。
④ 他最喜欢的颜色。
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“I'm 13 years old.”（知年龄①）；“white... That's my favourite colour.”（知最喜欢的颜色④）；“Do you know what my favourite subject is? It's science.”（知最喜欢的科目③）；文中第一段并未提及最喜欢的食物②。故选C。

questions.prompt: 22. What does the underlined word "<u>simple</u>" mean in Chinese?
questions.translation: 画线单词“simple”的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据下文举例“like 'nihao' and 'zaijian'”可知，“你好”和“再见”都是基础且简单的汉语日常用语，故simple在此处意为“简单的”。故选A。

questions.prompt: 23. What's Fred's purpose(目的)of writing the text?
options: To tell us his favourite things.
questions.translation: 弗雷德写这篇文章的目的是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段开头“I like making friends.”以及结尾句“This is me. Would you like to be friends with me?”可知，弗雷德进行自我介绍的主要目的是结交朋友。故选D。

sections.title: 四、句子还原
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容,从短文后的选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有两项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
Hi, I'm Rose. I can spell it to you, R-O-S-E. [24] Rose is my first name. My last name is Black. You can call me at 810-8088. [25] Eight is a good number. It means good luck.

[26] Do you know my favourite colour? Yeah, it's "blue".

This is my good friend, Jenny Brown. Her favourite colour is green. She has two green pens and two green cups. Her favourite number is "seven". [27] I often call her on weekends. She has a pet bird. It is cute.

Jenny and I both like science very much. We often learn it together after school. [28]
wordbank: A. I have three blue pens and three blue rulers.
B. My full name is Rose Black.
C. We want to be scientists one day.
D. My favourite number(数字) is "eight".
E. I often play ping-pong in the afternoon.
F. You can call her at 707-7877.
G. What does he like to do?

questions.answer: B. My full name is Rose Black.
questions.translation: 我的全名叫罗斯·布朗克。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着解释“Rose is my first name. My last name is Black.”（罗斯是我的名，布朗克是我的姓），因此前面引出自己的全名“My full name is Rose Black.”承前启后，选B。

questions.answer: D. My favourite number(数字) is "eight".
questions.translation: 我最喜欢的数字是“八”。
questions.explanation: 前文给出电话号码“810-8088”，后句指出“Eight is a good number. It means good luck.”，因此空格处提到最喜欢的数字是8（My favourite number is 'eight'.）与下文衔接紧密，选D。

questions.answer: A. I have three blue pens and three blue rulers.
questions.translation: 我有三支蓝色的钢笔和三把蓝色的尺子。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着说“Do you know my favourite colour? Yeah, it's 'blue'.”，第三段对比珍妮时也写道“Her favourite colour is green. She has two green pens and two green cups.”，可知第二段空格处应介绍自己拥有的蓝色物品，选A。

questions.answer: F. You can call her at 707-7877.
questions.translation: 你可以拨打707-7877给她打电话。
questions.explanation: 前句提到珍妮最喜欢的数字是7，后句提到“I often call her on weekends.”，因此此处介绍她的电话号码“You can call her at 707-7877.”符合语境，选F。

questions.answer: C. We want to be scientists one day.
questions.translation: 我们希望有一天能成为科学家。
questions.explanation: 前文提到“Jenny and I both like science very much. We often learn it together after school.”（珍妮和我都非常喜欢科学），因此选项C“我们希望有一天能成为科学家”承接上文兴趣与学科追求，选C。

sections.title: 五、语法填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文,根据上下文,在空白处填入适当的单词或括号内单词的适当形式。
sections.passage:
My name is Chen Jie. I live in Wuhan. My English name is Jenny Chen. I am twelve [29] (year) old. And I am [30] student in Class 2, Grade 7.

There [31] (be) nineteen girls and fifteen boys in my class. The teachers and students are kind [32] me. My friend Tony White is in my class, too. He is from the UK. He [33] (live) with his family in Wuhan now. Black is his favourite colour. [34] (he) schoolbag is black. He's really [35] (fun) and he often makes us laugh.

Sarah Hand is another friend of mine. Her favourite place is the dining hall [36] there are many kinds of delicious food. She likes [37] (play) ping-pong, but she [38] (can) play it well. We usually have a good time at school.

questions.translation: 我十二岁了。
questions.explanation: twelve是大于1的基数词，后接名词复数形式years，构成固定表达“... years old”。故选B。

questions.prompt: 30. And I am ______ student in Class 2, Grade 7.
questions.translation: 我是七年级二班的一名学生。
questions.explanation: student是可数名词单数，此处泛指“一名学生”，且student发音以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a。故选A。

questions.prompt: 31. There ______ (be) nineteen girls and fifteen boys in my class.
questions.translation: 我们班有十九名女生和十五名男生。
questions.explanation: There be句型遵循就近原则，紧随其后的主语nineteen girls为复数，且描述目前客观现状用一般现在时，be动词用are。故选B。

questions.prompt: 32. The teachers and students are kind ______ me.
questions.translation: 老师和同学们对我都很好。
questions.explanation: be kind to sb.是固定搭配，意为“对某人友好/和善”。故选A。

questions.prompt: 33. He ______ (live) with his family in Wuhan now.
questions.translation: 他现在和家人住在武汉。
questions.explanation: 主语He是第三人称单数，由now和全文基调可知用一般现在时表示目前居住状态，动词用第三人称单数形式lives。故选B。

questions.translation: 他的书包是黑色的。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词schoolbag需要用形容词性物主代词his（他的），句首首字母大写。故选B。

questions.prompt: 35. He's really ______ (fun) and he often makes us laugh.
questions.translation: 他真的很有趣，经常让我们发笑。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句“he often makes us laugh”可知，此处表示性格“滑稽的/有趣的”，用形容词funny（注：fun也可作形容词表示有趣的，中考题型规范中修饰人逗人发笑常考funny）。故选B。

questions.prompt: 36. Her favourite place is the dining hall ______ there are many kinds of delicious food.
questions.translation: 她最喜欢的地方是餐厅，因为那里有许多种美味的食物。
questions.explanation: 前后两句为因果关系，后半句是喜欢餐厅的原因，用连词because引导原因状语从句。故选A。

questions.translation: 她喜欢打乒乓球……
questions.explanation: like doing sth.或like to do sth.表示“喜欢做某事”，选项中提供动名词playing。故选C。

questions.translation: ……但是她打得不好。
questions.explanation: 连词but表示转折，说明虽然喜欢打，但是打得不好，用情态动词can的否定形式can't。故选B。

sections.title: 六、补全对话
sections.instruction: 根据下面对话中的情景,在每个空白处选出一个适当的语句,使对话恢复完整。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, I am Ding Hao. I'm new here. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I am from Beijing. And you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like to climb the mountains with my friends on weekends.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's cool. Oh, look! Is that tall man our English teacher?

options: A. Nice to meet you, too.
D. What do you like to do on weekends?

questions.answer: A. Nice to meet you, too.
questions.translation: 很高兴也认识你。
questions.explanation: 针对上句“Nice to meet you.”的标准礼貌回应是“Nice to meet you, too.”，选A。

questions.translation: 你来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据下句B回答“I am from Beijing.”可知，A此处询问对方来自哪里，用“Where are you from?”，选B。

questions.translation: 你多大了？
questions.explanation: 根据下句B回答“I am thirteen years old.”可知，此处询问年龄，用“How old are you?”，选C。

questions.answer: D. What do you like to do on weekends?
questions.translation: 你周末喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据下句B回答“I like to climb the mountains with my friends on weekends.”可知，此处询问周末喜好活动，用“What do you like to do on weekends?”，选D。

questions.translation: 不，他不是。
questions.explanation: 上句问“Is that tall man our English teacher?”，后句解释“He is our Chinese teacher.”（他是我们的语文老师），说明进行了否定回答，用“No, he isn't.”，选E。
